```ts
const files = ["src/index.ts", "src/utils.ts"];
const info = files.map(f => {
  const text = readTextFile(f);
  const lines = text.split("\n").length;
  return { path: f, lines };
});
console.log("File info:", JSON.stringify(info));

```ts
const content = `- src/index.ts (9 lines)
- src/utils.ts (3 lines)
`;

writeFile("MANIFEST.md", content);
console.log("MANIFEST.md written.");

const lsResult = shell("ls -la");
console.log("ls -la output:\n", lsResult.output);

const catResult = shell("cat MANIFEST.md");
console.log("cat MANIFEST.md:\n", catResult.output);
```Consumed fuel: 32,000 / 1,000,000 budget.
Returns:
```json
null
```

drwxr-xr-x 1 root root 4096 Mar  8 21:07 src

 - src/index.ts (9 lines)
- src/utils.ts (3 lines)
```
